title: Rock musicians, jazz musicians and what a bandleader expects
summary: Davenport and Wood discuss how young rock players decide together, and how hired players should follow the leader.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players
